# Horse Armor & Stuff x Fresh Animations FIX!
This is a patch to make version 1.2 of the "Horse Armor & Stuff x Fresh Animations" pack (originally for 1.21.11) compatible with version 1.21.1.

## Copyright
All rights reserved to the original creator (TanFen). This patch does NOT include their textures, only the code corrections necessary for compatibility.

### How to make it work
Download the original pack ("Horse Armor & Stuff x Fresh Animations" v1.2)..

Activate both in your Resource Packs menu and make sure to place this patch above the original pack in the list.
